heading-and-body.$description: Primary typeface for all headings and body text throughout the system.

h-over.$description: Oversized heading — for special cases requiring text larger than H1.

h1.$description: Primary page heading — top-level page titles.

h2.$description: Secondary heading — section titles within a page.

subheader.$description: Sub-heading — used below H1/H2 for supporting context.

title-lg.$description: Large title — prominent labels, card headers.

title.$description: Standard title — section labels, table headers, dialog titles.

body-lg.$description: Large body text — introductory paragraphs, featured content.

body.$description: Standard body text — primary reading size for paragraphs and descriptions.

caption.$description: Caption text — supporting labels, metadata, timestamps.

remark.$description: Smallest text — footnotes, disclaimers, fine print.

2xs.$description: Additional size 2xs — matches Remark size, for component-specific use.

xs.$description: Additional size xs — matches Caption size, for component-specific use.

sm.$description: Additional size sm — matches Body size, for component-specific use.

md.$description: Additional size md — matches Body-lg/Title size, for component-specific use.

xl.$description: Additional size xl — matches H2 size, for component-specific use.

semibold.$description: Default bold weight used for emphasized text, headings, and labels.
